definitions.explanation: The middle area or section of a physical space, region, object, or structure. Used for geographical locations, buildings, documents, and other things that have a discernible center.

examples.english: There is a mountain in the central part of the island.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中央部|ちゅうおうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an elevator in the center of the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦アフリカ{大陸|たいりく}→アフリカ大陸：29335_afurikatairiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中央部|ちゅうおうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な⟦{熱帯雨林|ねったいうりん}→熱帯雨林：19014_nettaiurin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A vast tropical rainforest stretches across the central part of the African continent.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧ (center) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part/section). A straightforward spatial term that is common in descriptions of geography, architecture, and layout. Slightly more formal and precise than ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧ (the very center).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中央部|ちゅうおうぶ}: the central part of a city
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中央部|ちゅうおうぶ}: central Japan
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中央部|ちゅうおうぶ}: the center of the chest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中心部|ちゅうしんぶ}→中心部：23774_chuushinbu⟧: the core/heart — emphasizes being the most important or active area, not just spatially central
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧: the very middle — more colloquial and emphatic
- ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧: center — the base word without ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧, used more broadly including for abstract concepts like government
